thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert -> LUMINEX dedpool gpu-node gpu-13 reported ECC_PARITY spike and driver reset. Severity: P1. Affected: Luminex VPC (dedicated pool). Pager: oncall@redwood

alice_oncall: on it. Paging SREs. Any immediate customer-facing impact known?

bob_sre: I'm seeing repeated GPU resets, nvml reports ECC count rising. Logs:
```text
[2026-03-16T21:02:11Z] gpu13: ECC_PARITY=12 -> reset
[2026-03-16T21:03:09Z] gpu13: driver oops, process pinned
```

alice_oncall: thanks. Starting evacuation of all Luminex containers from node gpu-13 -> `kubectl drain node/gpu-13 --ignore-daemonsets --force`

carla_infra: Start graceful drain, but note this node is on a spot-backed host; if it terminates we'll need tenant fallback path. Recommending `fallback:model-quantized-small` for low-latency sensitive jobs.

bob_sre: Draining now. ETA ~2m for KV cache flush + prefix cache warmup. If eviction fails, we'll trigger force-evict.

emily_support: Looping in Dan (AE) to prep a customer DM. Dan - want a quick note about failover and ETA?

dan_account: Yes — draft below, can send to Luminex SRE once we confirm no data loss.

emily_support: draft: "We're evacuating one GPU node in your dedicated pool due to hardware errors. Routing to a warm standby; you should see a transient increase in latency under heavy load. No data loss expected. We'll update in 15m or after replacement."

zack_oncall2: handoff to me in 10m if this goes to replacement. I'll coordinate RMA and spare assignment with hw team. @carla_infra - can you reserve a spare in us-west-2? :thumbsup: 

carla_infra: Reserving spare now. If spot host terminates we'll promote reserved node `ded-resv-45` and reattach. I'll post attach commands.

bob_sre: Drain complete. All Luminex pods evicted from gpu-13. No failed pods on restart. Monitoring for OOMs. Traffic shifted to pool fallback with 7% latency bump under peak.

alice_oncall: Good. Send the draft to Luminex now, EMILY do it and paste thread copy here.

emily_support: Sent DM to Luminex SRE (ACK from them: "thx, keep us posted").

carla_infra: If node recovers from reset within 30m we can rejoin; otherwise schedule replace. RMA ticket #RMA-8642 created.

zack_oncall2: I'll escalate for swap if ECC continues. For now, keep monitoring and I'll update in 15.

incident-bot: Incident severity remains P1. Current mitigation: node drained, tenant routed to fallback variants. Next update due 15m from root.
